correctness.rationale: The seven orbit entry types are correctly reconstructed from the four-dimensional equitable quotient and the eigenvalue-one leaf zero-sum subspaces, with hub-to-leaf entries divided by m. Independently recomputed the exact rational functions. For m=2,3,4,5 all 28 reduced numerator polynomials have zero strictly-positive roots, positive values at h=1 and positive-coefficient denominators; factors of h account for the zero root. The independently evaluated m=6,h=10 leaf diagonal is exactly -27666199/7741730811. The submitted symbolic shifted quartic N_{6+t}(10) has strictly negative coefficients for all t>=0. Order-three Taylor coefficients give strictly positive distance-<=3 off-diagonals at small h; the connected Laplacian spectral projection gives entrywise limit 1/(2m+2) for large h. This proves only endpoint positivity, not internal-stage positivity or failure-window uniqueness.
